❯ ports      what is listening on this machine                            4m ago
… (+1 more rows)

[↑↓/jk] move between snippets
[enter] run the snippet under the pointer
[c] copy its command to the clipboard
[e] rename it, in a row under the list
[d] delete it, after confirming it
[/] filter by name or by what the command is
[backspace] delete a character from the filter or the rename row
[esc] keep the name; clear the filter, then close it
[esc] back to the shell

glyphs
⚙  a read: a file, a search, a listing
$  a shell command
✎  an edit, a write, a patch or a memory
◇  a sub-agent
⇄  a call to a server not marked read-only
✻  the model writing its calls, counted as they arrive
⛁  a published report page
≡  a reading of the session
✓  a compaction that brought the window back
·  accepted, not started
▸  running
✦  the classifier is deciding
✗  failed
⊘  refused: dim by you, red by a rule
[?] hide the keys
